_comment: Per-contract WASM size budgets for the release build (#956). Budget = measured size + 5% headroom. The token budget reflects the batch transfer and batch execution code on main, raised by #914 for the privileged-action timelock entry points; the vesting budget by #918 for milestone tranches and claim delegates. The rate-limit and split budgets are raised by #914/#918 as well: both contracts link the bc-forge-admin crate, whose privileged-action timelock, role renounce, and proposal listing additions compile into their WASMs.
_measured_on: cargo 1.96.0, wasm32-unknown-unknown, --release, zero warnings. #914/#918 re-measured on 1.94.0; rate-limit/split re-measured on 1.96.0.
